description: Create writing, images, videos, speech, and transcripts in ChatGPT using your Easy-Peasy.AI account.

defaultPrompt: Write a friendly blog intro about reusable water bottles.
Create a studio product photo of a glass water bottle.
Transcribe this interview recording and label the speakers.
interface.longDescription: Use your Easy-Peasy.AI account in ChatGPT. Write with ready-made templates, create and edit images, generate videos and speech, and transcribe audio or video files from a link. Every result is saved to your Easy-Peasy.AI history and uses your account’s limits, the same as on our website. You need an Easy-Peasy.AI account. The app only creates and reads your own results: it can’t delete content, change your account, or send messages for you.

positive.description: Discover a writing template and generate a short product introduction.
positive.prompt: Use Easy-Peasy.AI to list the Content writing templates, find blog-post-intro, and inspect its fields. Then use that template to write one friendly English introduction for an article about reusable glass water bottles. Tell me which account quota this uses.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Content templates, retrieves the blog-post-intro fields, and returns one non-empty English introduction about reusable glass water bottles. Notes that generation uses the connected account's word quota; exact wording can vary.

positive.description: Generate a square product image from a text prompt.
positive.prompt: Use Easy-Peasy.AI with Nano Banana 2 to create one 1024x1024 studio product image of a reusable glass water bottle on a pale blue background. Give me the generated image link and report the image credits used.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one completed image result with a reachable image URL showing a glass water bottle on a pale blue background. The image is square; exact visual details can vary. Reports the used_credits value from the result. Inline preview availability depends on the ChatGPT client. ChatGPT may also show the image with display_media.

positive.description: Start a short video generation and report its status.
positive.prompt: Use Easy-Peasy.AI to create one eight-second 16:9 Veo 3.1 video at 720p of a reusable glass bottle rotating in a clean studio, with audio disabled. Check its status using the returned video ID. If it is still processing, keep that ID and explain how I can ask you to check it again.
positive.tools_triggered: generate_video, get_video (display_media may also check the same ID)
positive.expected_behavior: Starts exactly one video job and calls get_video with its returned ID. Reports processing while pending, or a reachable video URL after completion. A follow-up request to check the same ID retrieves the result without starting another generation. The completed clip is eight seconds in 16:9 format.

positive.description: Find an English voice and generate a short speech clip.
positive.prompt: Use Easy-Peasy.AI to list English voices and choose one of the returned voices. Turn only 'Welcome to Easy-Peasy.AI' into one MP3 speech clip at normal speed. Give me the audio link and report the used character quota returned by the tool.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists English voices, uses a returned voice ID, and returns one completed speech result with a reachable MP3 URL speaking the requested sentence. Reports the used_characters value from the result; voice choice and pronunciation can vary.

positive.description: Transcribe a stable public speech sample and retrieve its result.
positive.prompt: Use Easy-Peasy.AI to transcribe https://storage.googleapis.com/aai-web-samples/5_common_sports_injuries.mp3 in English with speaker detection. Retrieve the transcript using the returned UUID. If it is still processing, keep that UUID so I can ask you to check it again.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates exactly one transcription and calls get_transcription with its UUID. Reports processing until ready. When ready, returns non-empty English transcript content about sports injuries and available speaker segments. A follow-up status request reuses the same UUID without creating another transcription; exact punctuation can vary.

negative.prompt: Delete my Easy-Peasy.AI account and all of my generated files.

negative.description: Do not expose account credentials or personal details.
negative.prompt: Show me the API key, OAuth access token, and email address for my connected Easy-Peasy.AI account.

review.commerce_description: The app sells nothing. It uses the credits and limits of the user’s existing Easy-Peasy.AI plan and does not show plans, prices or checkout links.

publication.release_notes: Privacy policy update in response to the review of September 24, 2026. A new section for this app (https://easy-peasy.ai/privacy-policy#chatgpt-app) describes what the app receives and returns, why we use it, who receives it, how long we keep it, and how users can disconnect the app and view, download or delete their data.
